on_screen: PM ka video dekha, UPI PIN daala, paisa gaya
goal: Shocking fact: Deepfake ads on Facebook & Instagram are tricking people into giving away money via fake welfare schemes.
Show a real case where someone clicked on a fake PM video and got scammed out of Rs. 50,000.
Explain how deepfake videos are used to trick people into sharing UPI PIN and money.

on_screen: Stats & signs of a fake ad
goal: Show stats like 12,000+ reported cases in October 2026 and signs to spot fake videos.
Give actionable tips like checking transaction details, not sharing OTP or PIN, and contacting 1930.

goal: Remind viewers to verify all government schemes on official websites before acting.
Show a flowchart: fake video → call or link → request UPI PIN → funds transferred to scammers' accounts.
Highlight the risk of giving away UPI PIN and how it's used to drain accounts.
Encourage viewers to report scams and file complaints on cybercrime.gov.in.
End with a summary of the scam and call to action for comments and shares.
